content.text: UConn guard Azzi Fudd (35) looks for a way around South Carolina guard Tessa Johnson, left, during the national championship at the Final Four of the NCAA college basketball tournament, Sunday, April 6, 2025, in Tampa, Fla. (AP Photo/John Raoux)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Thomas Lagrone | tlagrone@al.comThe WNBA Draft is set to transpire tonight, as collegiate stars get ready to begin their professional careers. The event is scheduled to begin at 6:30 p.m. CT on ESPN. Fans can watch the WNBA Draft for free online by using the free trials offered by DIRECTV and Fubo TV. Alternatively, Sling offers a first-month discount to new users.There are multiple players looking to become the No. 1 overall pick in the WNBA Draft tonight: Olivia Miles, Azzi Fudd, and Awa Fam Thiam. Miles was a star guard at TCU that averaged nearly 20 points and seven assists during her senior season. Miles shot better than 35% from three-point range last year, which highlights her offensive ability. Fudd was an elite guard for UConn, as she averaged nearly 18 points per game last season. During her senior campaign, Fudd was able to shoot nearly 45% from beyond the arc. Fam Thiam is a center from Spain, who averaged nine points and four rebounds per game last year. She only averaged 21 minutes of action per game, so she played well during limited game time. Fans can watch the WNBA Draft for free online by using the free trials offered by DIRECTV and Fubo TV.
